note: Re-judged 2026-10-21 (independent judge) after both negatives moved to receiveEngineMetered (registry installed before openInterfaces, so the neighbor table knows eth0) and gained a control that the same Hello signed AuType 1 forms the neighbor on the same engine, which makes the 'no neighbor' assertion able to fail. Targeted overlays, observed: disabling only 'if h.AuType != keys[0].auType' reddens both null-into-password negatives (dropped 0, want 1); disabling only the no-key-chain non-Null refusal reddens TestRFC2328PasswordAuTypeIntoNullAreaDropped (dropped 0, want 1); renaming that reason to password-mismatch reddens both reason assertions, so the drop is attributed to the AuType check. Positive TestOSPFReceiveAcceptsMatchingAuType (AuType 1 into AuType 1, neighbor forms) unchanged. Residual, not a defect: TestOSPFReceiveDropsMismatchedAuType and TestRFC2328NullAuTypeIntoPasswordAreaDroppedForAuType now carry the same input and assertions (one test under two tags); the reverse negative asserts no reason label; the recorded discrimination breaks are whole-body panics, weaker than the line overlays above.
